title: A comparison of CNN architectures for Alzheimer's disease detection in single-view MRI scans
abstract: arXiv:2608.11762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a leading cause of death with no cure. Therefore, early detection is critical to slow progression and preserve quality of life. Diagnosis relies on medical history, cognitive tests, physical exams, and MRI brain scans, making deep learning suitable for Alzheimer's classification. This work proposes a benchmark that evaluates ten different convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures (including ResNet, DenseNet, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and VGG family models) under the same held-out test split protocol. A two-stage transfer learning and full fine-tuning pipeline is introduced to perform training using a class-balanced subset (3,900 images) derived from the OASIS medical imaging dataset, comprising 86,437 single-view MRI brain scans labeled into four classifications of Alzheimer's disease: Non-Demented, Very Mild Dementia, Mild Dementia, and Moderate Dementia. translated_title: 单视图MRI扫描中用于阿尔茨海默病检测的CNN架构比较
translated_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病是一种无治愈方法的致死性疾病，因此早期检测对于减缓病情进展和保持生活质量至关重要。诊断依赖于病史、认知测试、体检和MRI脑部扫描，这使得深度学习适用于阿尔茨海默病分类。本研究提出一个基准测试，在相同的保留测试集划分协议下，评估十种不同的卷积神经网络（CNN）架构（包括ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet、EfficientNet和VGG家族模型）。引入了一个两阶段迁移学习和全微调流程，使用从OASIS医学影像数据集中衍生的类别平衡子集（3,900张图像）进行训练，该数据集包含86,437张单视图MRI脑部扫描，标记为四种阿尔茨海默病分类：非痴呆、极轻度痴呆、轻度痴呆和中度痴呆。最佳结果由VGG16实现，准确率为0.9。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一基准，比较十种CNN架构在单视图MRI上检测阿尔茨海默病，发现VGG16在保持测试集上达到最佳准确率0.9。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified benchmark comparing ten CNN architectures for Alzheimer's disease detection in single-view MRI, finding VGG16 achieves the best accuracy of 0.9 on a held-out test set.
